title: FurBalls Racing
description:
FurBalls Racing is a fast-paced, platforming racing game that's silly and surprisingly challenging! Whether you want to have a party with friends or try to get perfect runs on every stage, FurBalls Racing is fun for all kinds of players!

• Play as over a dozen unique squishy FurBalls, each one with different attributes!

• Roll, wall jump, spin drift, and take creative shortcuts as you rush towards the finish line!

• Eat cheese, then use it to... shoot poop?... at your opponents...

• Play locally with up to four players in split screen!

• Race against up to fifteen CPU players in Grand Prix!

• Record and face your own best times as ghosts in Time Trials mode, where you can also race against challenging staff ghosts!

• Try to get medals on every stage to unlock more playable characters!

• Play online to race against distant friends or anyone else!

• Challenging unlockable content, secrets, crazy shortcuts, and hidden advanced game mechanics for speedrunners and other hardcore players!
description_short: FurBalls Racing is a challenging, fast-paced, platforming racing game that's fun for all kinds of players! Roll, wall jump, spin drift, take shortcuts, and... shoot poop?... as a squishy, fuzzy FurBall while rushing towards the finish line!... and avoiding poop.
